KV.description: Parmis's compatibility and migration store. Cloudflare creates and binds it automatically.

DB.description: Parmis's primary D1 database for settings, users, usage, logs, and authentication.

PARMIS_CLAIM_TOKEN.description: Optional but recommended. A random string that ties first-time setup to you: with it set, the panel only accepts its first admin password at /install?claim=<value>, so nobody who finds the address before you can claim the panel. Generate one with `openssl rand -hex 16` and keep a copy. Leave blank to keep the old behaviour, where whoever opens /install first sets the password. You can change or remove it later in Settings, Variables and Secrets.
